description: Perfect! Now I'll update the ChatMessageEditor component: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatMessageEditor.vue ``` Now update the Chat.vue file to handle the new properties in the save event: ```vue src/components/chat/Chat.vue onMessageEdited({ doc_id, content, profiles, llm_model }) { this.chatSvc.updateExistingMessage({ chat: this.chat, doc_id, update: { content, profiles, llm_model } }) this.editMessage = null this.saveChat() }, ``` | File | Changes | |------|---------| | `src/components/chat/ChatMessageEditor.vue` | Added ChatProfileSelector and ChatLLMModelSelector components; Added state for tracking profile and model changes; Updated template to display selectors; Updated save logic to include profiles and llm_model; Added watchers for profiles and model changes; Connected Editor save event with Ctrl+S | | `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | Updated `onMessageEdited` method to handle `profiles` and `llm_model` properties from the editor | ## Summary: 1. **ChatMessageEditor**: Now displays profile and LLM model selectors alongside message editing 2. **Profile Selection**: Users can select which profiles should be tagged with the message 3. **Model Selection**: Users can assign a specific LLM model to the message 4. **Save Detection**: Tracks changes to content, profiles, and model to enable/disable save button 5. **Keyboard Shortcut**: Ctrl+S triggers save (already implemented in Editor component)
